macro.title: Mortgage Rates Tick Up Even as the Odds of a Fed Rate Hike Decline
macro.what: In A Nutshell: There’s still upward pressure on rates, as bond market investors have all of the same worries that have caused mortgage rates to increase by 1.5 percentage points already this year
macro.why: Rates & inflation shape discount rates and housing affordability.
